limitations: RSS is whole-process resident memory, including the Torch runtime and CUDA context; peak is cumulative since process startup.
GPU memory from nvidia-smi includes unrelated application usage.
API timing includes validation and CPU-visible output conversion; CUDA timings are synchronized.
OneExperienceUpdate clones outside the measured interval and reuses the same generation16 state five times.
Benchmark initialization follows import and available CUDA context setup; it is not full application cold-start time.
All GPU metrics are actual values if CUDA was available; missing metrics remain null or explicitly unavailable.
No million-parameter model was allocated by this experiment.
